title: Hinomori Shiho — Our Sounds Combined〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aaand we're all set up! Time for another great practice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As the solo show gets closer, we need to make every session count.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Why don't we start with a run-through of everything?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Before that, there's something I want you guys to look at. I wrote up some things for us to be careful of when we're performing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These here are some general points... And then these are things I want each of us to watch out for.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
It's all laid out in neat bullet points.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're photocopies of my handwritten notes, so they might not be the easiest to read...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're absolutely fine, Shiho. Your handwriting is very neat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lemme see, lemme see! Uh, my points to work on are...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Song #1 intro: Don't rush ahead with synth. Stay focused during interlude.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Mine says:
“Keep in time with drums during half-time section. Remember effects pedal during guitar solo.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
“Be mindful of rests in bassline.”
Shiho, you even wrote notes for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It's easy to overlook your own slipups, so I want us all to help each other improve.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't believe you listed everything up so properly... Thank you so much, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were already each taking notes on the feedback we were getting, but this way we can all watch out for each other.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. That was my thinking behind this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, if we make good use of these, I think we can make our practice sessions more meaningful and effective.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I'm feeling inspired lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My groupmates have always been incredible creators, but lately they've been reaching new heights.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And so, I want to be able to express their work with my art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: With my art, I want to be able to tell the story within each song they make.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shinonome looked pained when she brought that up...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But she was still working on her art for her groupmates' sake.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to do the same, for the others' sake...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(No...
I want to do it so that we can bring everything we have to the solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You look kinda happy...
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just thinking how much better we'll be when we iron out every issue on the list.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I still can't believe you went to all that trouble... Just writing up these notes must've taken so long.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Absolutely. And you zeroed in on really specific points.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wasn't so bad. I was already taking regular notes anyway, so it was just a matter of summarizing them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Well, I did stay up kind of late working on it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This next show will be incredibly important for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not just because it's our first solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's also gonna be a huge opportunity to get a chance at debuting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why we need to pull out all the stops to be ready for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We gotta make the solo show a success, no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. For all these reasons, we're going to iron out every one of the issues I wrote down by the end of this week.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of cou—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, by the end of this week?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, this week.
That's the kind of pace we need if we want to be ready in time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But, all of these?! This will be so hard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You do want to make the solo show a success, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh, but that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Waaah! No fair, Shiho! You're ruthless!
If you say it like that, I can't not do it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to check through the notes properly, so at least have the mercy to give me time to read them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course, go ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, time to have a read-through...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami. There's another note about us keeping in time during the third song, so let's discuss that later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure thing. That was also on my mind, so I'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought I might be asking too much of them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But they're doing their best to make it happen.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright, I should review my notes too.)
